{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid Control Army''' was a small force of twelve [[Droid/Legends|droids]] owned and employed by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]—but manipulated and controlled by [[Hurlo Holowan]], the droid engineer of Groodo's [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit]] ''[[Sun Runner]]'' transport—to take over [[Fondor Spaceport]] in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].

The force consisted of droids that traditionally and by [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] reputation were deemed harmless enough, which, indeed, would not have seemed out of place on any [[Space station/Legends|space station]] under normal circumstances—clearly the reason that they'd so easily been able to infiltrate the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]: a modified [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]], whose upper casing contained a rapid-[[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]]; six heavily modified [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series medical assistant droids]], which, instead of wielding medical tools, brandished numerous deadly weapons and were mounted on [[Treadwell locomotion unit|treadwell]] bases for greater mobility; and five [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] modified with [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusion-cutters]] and periscopic micro-[[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].

A team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on a [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission to Fondor]], particularly via the singular efforts of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], destroyed the [[Army/Legends|army]] and foiled Groodo's plot.
